# ColorOS Live Lyrics Bridge v4.0.0

4.0 is a full architecture release. Player-specific hooks have moved into 12 independent Providers
that publish native `MediaMetadata["lyricInfo"]` from the player's own MediaSession. Bridge now
runs only in `system` and `com.android.systemui`, consumes the same native data as ColorOS, and
focuses on generic rendering, AOD, appearance, translation controls, and SystemUI compatibility.

This is a coordinated breaking upgrade from 3.8.x. Update Bridge and the Providers you use from
this release, and remove the old Provider scope from the same player before enabling its 4.0
replacement.

## Bridge architecture

- Removed the direct-v4 receiver, registry, source/sender mapping, external protocol module, and
  player-process adapters.
- Bridge no longer knows Provider application IDs or requests a private lyric payload.
- Scope is reduced to `system` and `com.android.systemui`.
- Native `lyricInfo` is parsed once per publication and shared by identity, cleanup, translation,
  official-list alignment, and renderer preparation.
- Large SystemUI hook responsibilities were split into bootstrap, diagnostics, media/lyrics policy,
  model assembly, frame resolution, draw coordination, and named player compatibility owners.
- Debug logging uses structured `[CLL]` events, separate preferences, throttling, redaction, and
  logcat/Xposed sinks. Debug remains off by default and does not change behavior.

## Lyrics and appearance

- Added an independent **Lyric brightness & fading** page.
- Separate controls for active text, unrevealed active text, active translation, translation
  progress, inactive text, and inactive translation.
- Inactive translation can follow the main inactive opacity or keep its own value.
- Native top/bottom RecyclerView edge fading has configurable enable and length controls.
- Optional additional inactive-row fade is independent from blur/scale.
- Default, Soft, Vivid, and Minimal presets now own the new brightness/fading fields; any deviation
  becomes Custom.
- Preview layout, row spacing, vertical centering, integer fade-length steps, full-width bottom dock,
  longer sliders, and themed discard confirmation were refined from device feedback.
- Center and right alignment now scale around the correct alignment pivot instead of stretching from
  the left edge.

## Translation controls

- Active translation is brighter than inactive translation while remaining below the active main
  lyric by default.
- Translation progress and base translation opacity are controlled separately.
- Media-card translation state updates immediately without waiting for pause/play.
- Button presentation preserves each player's action-row ownership and uses a canonical white tint
  with enabled/disabled alpha instead of inheriting black host tint.
- Player translation defaults and remembered state remain keyed by player package, not Provider APK.

## Configuration and cleanup

- Added **Bridge configuration backup & restore** on the main settings page.
- Backup covers UI/schema, global/per-player translation settings, opening-cleanup rules and
  per-track corrections, debug settings, and settings language.
- Restore validates namespaces/types, rolls back failed writes, and replays the required runtime
  update events.
- Full reset requires confirmation.
- Built-in opening-cleanup rules remain available but default to disabled; the Bridge no longer
  applies unconditional dirty-data correction to every native payload.

## 4.0 Provider suite

Each Provider is an independent Root / LSPosed module. A supported ColorOS SystemUI can consume its
native `lyricInfo` even when Bridge is not installed; Bridge adds optional generic enhancements.

| Player | Provider asset | Validated host baseline | Lyrics |
|---|---|---|---|
| Salt Player | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-Salt-v4.0.0.apk` | 12.3.0-alpha03 | word timing, translation |
| Cone / GP | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-Cone-v4.0.0.apk` | 1.2.0 profile / GP | timeline, translation |
| KuWo | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-KuWo-v4.0.0.apk` | 12.2.0.0 | official append, word timing, translation |
| LX / Walnut | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-LX-v4.0.0.apk` | LX 1.8.4 / Walnut 26.07.16 | word timing, translation |
| Poweramp | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-Poweramp-v4.0.0.apk` | build 1025 | sidecar/embedded lyrics, translation |
| Metrolist | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-Metrolist-v4.0.0.apk` | 13.6.1 | BetterLyrics/LrcLib/KuGou, no translation |
| KuGou / Concept | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-KuGou-v4.0.0.apk` | 20.8.0 / 5.2.61 | official append, word timing, translation |
| QQ Music | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-QQ-v4.0.0.apk` | 20.7.5.8 | official append, QRC, translation |
| NetEase / Honor / 9.0.40 | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-NetEase-v4.0.0.apk` | 9.5.70 / 3.5.20 / 9.0.40 | official append or constructed, translation |
| Apple Music | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-Apple-v4.0.0.apk` | 6.5.2 | JNI TTML word timing, translation |
| Spotify | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-Spotify-v4.0.0.apk` | 9.1.78.2208 | line/word Color Lyrics, no translation |
| QiShui | `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-QiShui-v4.0.0.apk` | 20.7.0 | TrackLyric/cache, word timing, translation |

QQ Music HD, MusicFree, Gramophone, and Symfonium are not part of the 4.0 Provider matrix.
Halcyon, Flamingo, QZ Music, and PrismMusic have package-only SystemUI lyric-entrance,
media-history, and AOD compatibility. This is not a source whitelist: each app must publish standard
native `lyricInfo` from its own MediaSession, and old v4 broadcasts are not accepted.

This project does not distribute Lyricon Providers. Obtain them from the
[original LyricProvider project](https://github.com/tomakino/LyricProvider), and report Lyricon
display/product issues there.

## Upgrade from 3.8.x

1. Back up the complete Bridge configuration from the main settings page.
2. Install `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Bridge-v4.0.0.apk` over the official 3.8.1 build.
3. Keep only `system` and `com.android.systemui` in Bridge scope.
4. For every player you use, uninstall/disable the old Provider or remove its player scope.
5. Install the matching `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-<Name>-v4.0.0.apk` and select only its listed
   host package(s).
6. Restart the player and SystemUI; reboot after the first installation or scope migration.
7. Do not enable old and new Providers for the same player at the same time.

The complete application-ID/scope table and downgrade instructions are in:

- [3.8.x → 4.0 migration guide (Chinese)](../../docs/4.0/MIGRATION-3.8-TO-4.0.zh-CN.md)
- [3.8.x → 4.0 migration guide (English)](../../docs/4.0/MIGRATION-3.8-TO-4.0.md)

Downgrading is not configuration-lossless because 3.8.x does not understand every schema-v3 field.
Keep the 4.0 backup and be prepared to reset settings in the older version.

## Known limits

- ColorOS lock-screen lyrics are a private SystemUI feature; system updates can require a Bridge
  compatibility update.
- Player-private lyric interfaces can change after app updates.
- Spotify and Metrolist do not provide translation in the current matrix.
- QQ Music HD is not supported.
- Word highlighting and translation cannot appear when the lyric source does not provide those
  lanes.

## Release assets

The release contains exactly 16 assets:

- `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Bridge-v4.0.0.apk`
- 12 `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Provider-<Name>-v4.0.0.apk` files
- `ColorOS-Live-Lyrics-Providers-v4.0.0.zip`
- `release-assets-v4.0.0.json`
- `SHA256SUMS`

The Provider ZIP contains APKs only and is not a Recovery-flashable package. Install only the
Providers for players you use.
